exposure: antithrombotic regime (100 mg aspirin daily, subcutaneous enoxaparin)
cohort: The study included 10 women of child-bearing age who had received dedicated iliac venous stents and subsequently experienced 13 post-stent pregnancies.
finding: Dedicated venous stents demonstrated good performance throughout pregnancy and postpartum, with all stents remaining patent, and no cases of deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, or bleeding complications.
followup_time: median 60 months post-stent for latest follow-up
